name: Unmapped source account
detector: source account not present in the ERP chart of accounts
description: A posting carries a source account that does not exist in the Aurora chart, so the mapping engine has nothing to map it to. It must land in suspense and block the close, never default into other expenses.
detail: Aurora account 6100 changed to 6199, which is not in the chart

name: Intercompany amount mismatch
detector: entity-pair intercompany balance does not net to zero
description: The buying entity restates a management fee by 4.5% while the selling entity does not. Both trial balances still close, so only a control that tests the entity PAIR -- rather than the aggregate -- can find it.
detail: the buyer restates the management fee by 4.5%; its own trial balance still closes, but the entity pair no longer eliminates

name: Missing FX rate
detector: currency-period-rate-type absent from the rate table
description: The closing rate for one currency and period is absent from the rate file. Translation must fail rather than silently apply zero or carry a stale rate.

name: Duplicate journal identifier
description: A journal is present twice in the same extract, as happens when a period is loaded twice. It doubles the entity's result while still balancing.

name: Invalid cost centre
detector: cost centre not present in the cost centre master
description: A posting references a cost centre that is not in the master, which would otherwise become an orphan dimension key.
detail: cost centre 999-999 does not exist in the master

name: Malformed localised amount
detector: amount does not parse under the declared locale
description: A Kestrel amount is written with a period decimal separator instead of a comma. Parsed under the German locale, 1.234,56 becomes 1.23456 -- a thousand-fold error that still looks like a number.
detail: German comma decimal replaced by a period separator

name: Posting date outside its period
detector: posting date month does not match the fiscal period
description: A line is stamped with a posting date in a different month from the fiscal period it is filed under.
detail: posting date moved into the following month

name: Payroll misclassified across the gross margin line
detector: payroll line whose department contradicts its cost centre function
description: A direct production payroll posting carries an SGA department, so Aurora's conditional split resolves it to operating expense instead of cost of sales. Every balancing control still passes; only gross margin moves.
detail: production payroll re-tagged to an SGA department; gross margin moves, every balancing control still passes

name: Unbalanced journal
detector: journal whose lines do not sum to zero
description: One leg of a two-sided entry is removed, so the entity's trial balance no longer closes to zero.
detail: one leg of journal AU202411200001180 removed

name: Posting before the consolidation effective date
detector: period earlier than the entity's consolidation effective date
description: Halden Valve posts a period before its 1 April 2023 acquisition date, which would overstate FY2023 and corrupt the organic growth bridge.
detail: Halden Valve posts February 2023, before its 1 April 2023 acquisition
